schema: CREATE INDEX subject_canonical on subjects(canonical) where canonical is not null
CREATE INDEX subject_queue ON subjects(first_source) WHERE status='pending'

CREATE TABLE biographies (
 pageid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, wiki_revid INTEGER NOT NULL,
 wiki_timestamp TEXT NOT NULL, retrieved_at TEXT NOT NULL, qid TEXT NOT NULL,
 wikidata_revid INTEGER NOT NULL, wiki_gzip BLOB NOT NULL, wikidata_gzip BLOB NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE origin_candidates (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE origin_links(subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id),
    source_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES origin_sources(id),source_line INTEGER NOT NULL,
    candidate_key INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES origin_candidates(id),
    PRIMARY KEY(subject_id,source_id,source_line)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE origin_sources (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, source_pageid INTEGER NOT NULL, source_title TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_revid INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(source_pageid, source_title, source_revid))
CREATE TABLE people_scheduler (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE subjects (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, first_source TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', canonical TEXT, qid TEXT, error TEXT)

CREATE TRIGGER origin_links_original_key BEFORE INSERT ON origin_links BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM origin_links l
     JOIN origin_sources existing ON existing.id=l.source_id
     JOIN origin_sources incoming ON incoming.id=NEW.source_id
     WHERE l.subject_id=NEW.subject_id AND l.source_line=NEW.source_line
       AND existing.source_pageid=incoming.source_pageid AND existing.source_revid=incoming.source_revid)
    THEN RAISE(IGNORE) END; END

CREATE VIEW origins AS SELECT s.title AS title,p.source_pageid AS source_pageid,
    p.source_title AS source_title,p.source_revid AS source_revid,l.source_line AS source_line,
    c.candidate_id AS candidate_id FROM origin_links l JOIN subjects s ON s.id=l.subject_id
    JOIN origin_sources p ON p.id=l.source_id JOIN origin_candidates c ON c.id=l.candidate_key
